segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the quote in the CRM. We have you at 48 seats for the operations team, annual term starting February 1, with onboarding in January. Does that still match what you’re planning?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly, yeah. We’re at 46 confirmed users right now, and I think two more managers will be added before go-live. So 48 is fine. The main thing is making sure the first invoice doesn’t hit until after January 15.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The billing tool is currently set to invoice on contract signature, so I’ll adjust that to January 16. Same net 30 terms we discussed, so payment due February 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. And the total was $31,680 for the year, right? I need to send the final number to procurement this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That’s 48 seats at $55 per seat per month, billed annually, so $31,680. Onboarding is waived, and support is included in the standard plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal had one note on the renewal language. They’re asking for 60 days’ notice before renewal instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that should be fine. I’ll send it to deal desk just to update the order form and the MSA reference. It shouldn’t change pricing or the approval path.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If we can get the revised paperwork today, I can probably get signatures by Friday. Our internal kickoff is January 9, and we want your team on that call.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I’ll hold January 9 at 11 a.m. Eastern with our implementation lead. Once the order form is signed, we’ll send the intake sheet and set up the admin workspace.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the revised order form and the invoice timing in writing, and I’ll move it through procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll have it over by 2 p.m. Eastern, and I’ll call out the 48 seats, $31,680 annual total, January 16 invoice date, and February 1 contract start.
